summary: Corporate card transactions misallocated after nightly ETL truncated merchant mapping table
description:
Issue summary:
Finance Ops reported that over 1,200 corporate card transactions posted yesterday were bucketed to the 'Unassigned' cost center or incorrectly mapped to HQ GL codes. Impact:
- Expense approvals blocked for several teams (EMEA/NA regions).
- Month-end reconciliations show ~USD 48,000 variance on corporate card ledger.
- Some reimbursements/pre-approvals prevented from being included in month-end accruals.
Environment:
- Production corporate card ingestion pipeline (daily ETL) -> master_merchant_map table (data-platform) -> accounting mapping service -> AP system.
Observed behavior:
- Yesterday's ETL job truncated master_merchant_map mid-run and reloaded a partial dataset (no merchant_id -> cost_center mappings for ~18% of records).
- Transactions with affected merchant_ids defaulted to 'Unassigned' cost center and HQ GL code 9999.
Expected behavior:
- Graceful ETL reload that preserves previous mapping if a partial load occurs, or fails the job and raises alert so downstream systems don't default to fallback GL codes.
Priority rationale: Finance close is this week; misallocations will cause late adjustments and possible payment delays.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger nightly ETL job manually with a simulated interrupted load (kill process after truncate, before full insert).
Observe master_merchant_map table contents: partial rows present and gaps for merchant_ids observed in card feed.
Replay corporate card feed against mapping service; transactions match fallback GL 9999 or 'Unassigned' cost center.
Run reconciliation report showing mismatch counts by merchant_id and cost_center.
Verify that alerts are not emitted when row count delta between previous load and current load exceeds threshold (missing guardrail).
logs: Airflow dag: card_ingest_master_map_v2 run_id: 2026-03-09T23:00:00. Last successful full load: 2026-03-08T23:00:00. Error snippet from run: 'psql: error: could not execute query: connection lost during COPY FROM STDIN'. DB: analytics-master. Affected merchant_id examples: M_44821, M_99104, M_2207. Accounting mapping fallback: GL 9999 assigned to 1023 rows. Full log location: s3://redwood-logs/etl/card_ingest/2026-03-09/ (internal access only).
comments: Finance Ops (Elena Morales) 2026-03-10: Noticed large number of CC transactions pending in 'Unassigned' bucket during daily review. Asked if this will block payroll run for expense reimbursements.
Data Platform (Marco Ruiz) 2026-03-10: Confirmed ETL job showed connection interrupt during COPY; task retried and inserted partial data. Investigating why partial loads are allowed to commit.
SRE (Tomás Nguyen) 2026-03-11: Network flakiness during DB maintenance window may have caused connection reset. Suggest pinning ETL to maintenance-safe window and adding integrity checks.
Finance Ops (Elena Morales) 2026-03-11: Requesting immediate remediation plan and list of affected cost centers so we can prioritize manual review for month-end close.
Engineering (Marco Ruiz) 2026-03-12: I will implement a row-count guard and transactional replace pattern in the loader. Preparing a hotfix PR and a backfill plan; will share estimated ETA shortly.
investigation_notes: Confirmed root cause: master_merchant_map truncation occurs at start of load, followed by COPY FROM STDIN. If COPY fails mid-stream, table remains truncated because previous data already removed.
No existing row-count or checksum validation in post-load step to detect partial loads (current check only validates presence of table).
Affected window: card ingestion batches between 2026-03-09T23:05:00 and 2026-03-09T23:40:00. Approximately 1,237 transaction rows affected across NA/EMEA feeds.

Temporary remediation attempted: re-run last successful full dump from 2026-03-08 and apply to mapping table; however, some newly onboarded merchant mappings (added 2026-03-09 morning) were not present, so manual reconciliation required for ~42 merchant_ids.

Risk: automated default mapping GL 9999 is used by downstream accounting exports; if not remediated before AP file generation, vendor cost allocation in ERP will be wrong and will require manual journal entries.
resolution:
In progress: Short-term mitigation: restored previous full copy as of 2026-03-08 and flagged missing merchant_ids for manual mapping by Finance Ops. Data Platform to deploy hotfix by 2026-03-13 that changes loader to 'COPY into staging table then atomic swap' and adds a post-load row-count threshold alert.
Planned steps:
1) Deploy hotfix loader (staging swap + row-count guard) - ETA 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC.
2) Re-run full mapping reload from canonical source and verify row counts vs snapshot.
3) Finance Ops to provide mapping for 42 new merchant_ids by 2026-03-13 12:00 UTC.
4) Run backfill to correct affected transactions and regenerate AP export; expected to clear 'Unassigned' bucket for impacted transactions.
5) Create a runbook for ETL failures with rollback/alert steps and link to Confluence.
Follow-up: schedule a postmortem and add integration test to CI for loader idempotency.
